snippet.title: Casa De Diamantes - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Casa De Diamantes releases November 13th on Steam!

Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower, on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous casino, the Casa De Diamantes.

Wishlist the Game & Play the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1814890/Casa_De_Diamantes/

X: https://x.com/DiamantesCasa
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/casa_de_diamantes/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@soulpixeliv

Soundtrack by Holly Hitchcock
